title: CareConstraint
description: A partial set of care requirements — exactly what a care label states, and no more. Every property is optional on purpose: an absent property means the label did not state it, which is categorically different from the label permitting it. A creased label whose drying symbol is illegible must omit `tumbleDryAllowed` rather than send `true`, so the domain core's rule table fills the gap instead of reading silence as permission. See docs/adr/0004-label-overrides-rules.md.

method.description: How the garment may be washed.

washTemperature.description: The word the label printed, when it printed one rather than a number.

maxTempC.description: Maximum wash temperature in Celsius, as printed in the tub.

agitation.description: Mechanical action, from the bars beneath the tub. A tub with NO bars means `normal` and must be reported as such — absence of bars is a stated fact under ISO 3758, not silence.

tumbleDryAllowed.description: From the circle-in-a-square. Omit when the symbol was absent or illegible.

warnings.description: Instructions labels print as words rather than symbols.
